mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM ts_agent_chat_message_event e INNER JOIN ts_agent_chat_session s ON s.id = e.session_id INNER JOIN ts_agent_chat_message m ON m.id = e.message_id AND m.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.session_status != 'deleted' AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND e.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
